title: KUZ STRAWBERRY WATERMELON ICE – 6000 PUFFS
description:
Unleash the ultimate vaping experience with the Kuz Disposable Vape, now offering a remarkable 6000 puffs of rich, satisfying vapor. The Kuz C6000 is for those who demand more from their vaping experience—more puffs, more flavor, and more convenience. With no need to refill or recharge, you can enjoy the smooth, rich vapor from the first puff to the last.

Key Features:

Robust Flavour Selection: Choose from a variety of flavours crafted to perfection for every preference.
Zero Maintenance Required: Pre-charged and pre-filled for immediate use right out of the package.
Leak-Proof Technology: Engineered to provide a clean vaping experience without the mess.
High-Quality Build: Durable construction that withstands the rigours of daily use.

PRODUCT PACKAGE
1 x KUZ 6000 Puff disposable vape pod

FAQS ABOUT KUZ 6000 PUFFS
1. How many puffs can I get from KUZ C6000?
Each KUZ C6000 device provides an impressive 6000 puffs, ensuring a long-lasting vaping experience.

2. How long does the KUZ C6000 Puffs last?
With a total of 6000 puffs, this device can last heavy vapers for approximately two weeks and occasional vapers up to four weeks.

3. Is the Kuz C6000 refillable?
No, it is not refillable. Once the e-liquid is depleted, the device should be disposed of responsibly.

4. Do I need to charge the Kuz 6000 puff?
No, the Kuz Disposable Vape comes pre-charged and is ready to use out of the box.

5. How much does the KUZ 6000 puff cost?
You will get a cheaper price when buying in bulk.
